findings: 28 linkProgram and56 compileShader submissions recur on the single warmed target (same counts in preparation warm-up), demonstrating repeated program creation.
Native program/shader queries account for284.9ms,38.8% of734.3ms; they do not explain the whole interval. getProgramInfoLog is the largest selected native cost.
Selected texture/buffer allocation/upload calls total0.1ms rounded; no large selected upload cost observed.
No deleteProgram/deleteTexture/scene-unmount callbacks were instrumented; resource disposal or the remaining446.8ms CPU/driver work is not directly attributed.
This does not establish a DEV-only difference: historic DEV evidence had pre-goal PoolModel/RawShell WIP, cache/DPR regimes differ.
nextFixHypothesis: Retaining approved water/reflection material resources while dry may prevent re-creation; validate only as an isolated causal experiment. Visibility must still suppress water and reflection work in dry stages, with no appearance, liner, light or quality change. Do not ship checkShaderErrors suppression.
